# Custom grid item component design (2026-02-21 15:11Z)

_**User**_

# Custom Grid Item for Portfolio — Enhancement Prompt

**Reference**: Inspired by [nevflynn.com](https://nevflynn.com/) but must be **distinct**, not a copy.

**Skills to apply**: `/frontend-design` `/web-design-guidelines` `/shadcn-ui` `/tailwind-v4-shadcn`

**Context files**:
- `.specstory/history/2026-02-19_10-37Z-website-animation-techniques.md` — animation patterns, grid behavior, navbar interaction
- `.specstory/history/2026-02-20_10-49Z-color-palette-for-portfolio-project.md` — Graphite / Cyan / Ember palette (already in `app/globals.css`)

---

## Objective

Design and implement a **custom grid item component** for the portfolio bento grid (`components/public/portfolio-grid.tsx`). The item should feel inspired by Nev Flynn’s bento-style blocks (compact, content-rich, interactive) but with its own visual identity and behavior.

---

## What to Do (High-Level)

1. **Define grid item variants** — Create distinct item types (e.g. hero/about, project card, article teaser, CTA/newsletter, media/now-playing) that map to your sections (All, About me, Projects, Experience, Contact). Each variant should have its own layout and content structure.

2. **Design the visual system** — Use the existing Graphite / Cyan / Ember palette from `globals.css`. Avoid Nev’s black/white/pink; lean on `--primary` (cyan-teal), `--accent` (ember), and semantic tokens (`bg-card`, `border-border`, `text-muted-foreground`). Ensure light and dark themes both work.

3. **Implement the component(s)** — Build a reusable `GridItem` (or variant-specific components) that:
   - Accepts props for size (`w`, `h`), variant type, and content
   - Uses shadcn/ui primitives where appropriate (Card, Button, etc.)
   - Follows Tailwind v4 patterns (`@theme inline`, CSS variables, no `@apply` in `@layer base` per tailwind-v4-shadcn skill)
   - Integrates cleanly with `react-grid-layout` (no layout conflicts)

4. **Add motion and interaction** — Apply animation techniques from the animation spec story:
   - Staggered entrance on load (e.g. `animation-delay` or Motion `staggerChildren`)
   - Hover/focus states with clear feedback
   - Honor `prefers-reduced-motion` (reduced or no animation when requested)
   - Animate only `transform` and `opacity` for compositor-friendly performance

5. **Ensure accessibility and guidelines compliance** — Follow Vercel Web Interface Guidelines:
   - Semantic HTML (`article`, `section`, `h2`, etc.)
   - Icon-only buttons with `aria-label`
   - Visible focus states (`focus-visible:ring-*`)
   - Correct heading hierarchy
   - Images with `alt`, `width`, `height`

6. **Differentiate from Nev Flynn** — Avoid direct mimicry:
   - Different typography (avoid Moranga/Silka; choose a distinctive pairing)
   - Different layout rhythm (asymmetry, spacing, or density)
   - Different interaction patterns (e.g. no drag if you prefer static; or different drag feedback)
   - Your own “memorable hook” (e.g. a signature accent treatment, border style, or micro-interaction)

7. **Wire into `PortfolioGrid`** — Replace placeholder colored divs with the new grid item components, passing real or mock content. Ensure section filtering (All, About me, Projects, etc.) shows the correct item set per section.

---

## Constraints

- Use **pnpm** for package management.
- Stay within **shadcn/ui**, **Tailwind v4**, and **Motion** (per AGENTS.md).
- Do not introduce new color tokens; use the existing palette.
- Keep the grid responsive; items should behave well at different viewport widths.

---

## Deliverables

- `GridItem` (or equivalent) component(s) in `components/public/`
- Updated `portfolio-grid.tsx` using the new items
- Any new CSS or theme tweaks in `app/globals.css` if needed (following the four-step Tailwind v4 pattern)

  "plan": "# Custom Grid Item for Portfolio — Implementation Plan\n\n## Current State\n\n- **[portfolio-grid.tsx](components/public/portfolio-grid.tsx)**: Uses &#96;react-grid-layout&#96; with placeholder colored divs. Section filter via &#96;nuqs&#96; (All, About me, Proyects, Experience, Contact). Grid Item Variant System\n\nDefine a variant type and map each section to appropriate item types:\n\n| Section | Variant | Content |\n|---------|---------|---------|\n| All | hero, project, experience, cta, about | Mixed bento |\n| About me | about, hero | Bio + intro |\n| Projects | project | Project cards |\n| Experience | experience | Experience cards |\n| Contact | cta | Newsletter, social links |\n\n**Variant types** (to implement):\n\n- &#96;hero&#96; — Large intro block (name, tagline, status)\n- &#96;about&#96; — Bio / short about text\n- &#96;project&#96; — Project card (title, description, link, skills)\n- &#96;experience&#96; — Experience card (role, company, dates)\n- &#96;cta&#96; — Newsletter signup or contact CTA\n- &#96;media&#96; — Optional “now playing” / media block (future)\n\n---\n\n## 2. Keeps layout logic in one place and avoids prop drilling.\n\n**Props interface** (example):\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;ts\ntype GridItemVariant = 'hero' | 'about' | 'project' | 'experience' | 'cta' | 'media';\n\ninterface GridItemProps {\n  variant: GridItemVariant;\n  layout?: { w?: number; h?: number };  // Optional overrides\n  index?: number;  // For stagger delay\n  section?: string;  // For filter opacity\n  children?: ReactNode;  // Or variant-specific content props\n  // Variant-specific: project?, experience?, etc.\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nUse shadcn &#96;Card&#96; as the base wrapper where appropriate (&#96;project&#96;, &#96;experience&#96;, &#96;cta&#96;). Hero and about can use &#96;article&#96;/&#96;section&#96; with custom styling.\n\n---\n\n## 3. Visual System (Graphite / Cyan / Ember)\n\nUse existing tokens from [globals.css](app/globals.css):\n\n- **Surfaces**: &#96;bg-card&#96;, &#96;bg-background&#96;, &#96;border-border&#96;\n- **Primary (cyan-teal)**: &#96;text-primary&#96;, &#96;bg-primary/10&#96;, &#96;border-primary&#96; — links, active states, accents\n- **Accent (ember)**: &#96;text-accent&#96;, &#96;bg-accent/10&#96; — CTAs, highlights, badges\n- **Text**: &#96;text-foreground&#96;, &#96;text-muted-foreground&#96;\n\n**Differentiation from Nev**:\n\n- Nev: black/white/pink, Moranga/Silka\n- Ours: Graphite base + cyan + ember; different typography (see below)\n- **Memorable hook**: e.g. left-border accent stripe on hover, or subtle gradient mesh on hero; avoid Nev’s exact layout rhythm\n\n**Tailwind v4**: No new tokens. Use &#96;@theme inline&#96; mappings only. No &#96;@apply&#96; in &#96;@layer base&#96; per [tailwind-v4-shadcn](.cursor/skills/tailwind-v4-shadcn/SKILL.md).\n\n---\n\n## 4. Typography Differentiation\n\nCurrent: Geist + Geist Mono. To avoid “AI slop” and Nev’s Moranga/Silka:\n\n- **Option A**: Keep Geist for body, add a display font (e.g. **Instrument Sans**, **Satoshi**, **General Sans**) for headings/hero\n- **Option B**: Use **Geist** for headings and **Geist Mono** for labels/metadata — invert current usage for a more technical feel\n- **Option C**: Add one distinctive font (e.g. **Fraunces** for display) — per [frontend-design](.cursor/skills/frontend-design/SKILL.md)\n\nRecommendation: Add a display font in &#96;layout.tsx&#96; and apply to hero/headings. Motion and Interaction\n\nPer [animation spec](.specstory/history/2026-02-19_10-37Z-website-animation-techniques.md) and Web Interface Guidelines:\n\n- **Entrance**: Staggered fade-up using Motion &#96;staggerChildren&#96; or &#96;animation-delay&#96; (index-based)\n- **Properties**: Only &#96;transform&#96; and &#96;opacity&#96; (compositor-friendly)\n- **Reduced motion**: &#96;@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)&#96; — disable or shorten animations\n- **Hover/focus**: Scale or opacity change; &#96;focus-visible:ring-*&#96; for focus\n- **No** &#96;transition: all&#96; — list properties explicitly\n\nExample pattern:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;tsx\n&lt;motion.article\n  initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 12 }}\n  animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}\n  transition={{\n    duration: 0.4,\n    delay: index * 0.05,\n    ...(prefersReducedMotion &amp;&amp; { duration: 0, delay: 0 })\n  }}\n  className=\"...\"\n/&gt;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nUse &#96;useReducedMotion()&#96; from Motion when available.\n\n---\n\n## 6.
